prompt: All four Market Pier departures below have confirmed headcounts. Which one should still be set aside for the capacity analysis because of its display?
promptZh: 下列市場碼頭四個班次的人數都已確認。哪個班次仍應因看板資訊問題暫不納入運量分析？

options.text: A wrong time appeared at the street entrance while passengers were still boarding, but staff corrected it before the ferry left.
options.zh: 乘客仍在登船時，臨街入口顯示了錯誤時間，但工作人員在渡輪開出前已更正。
options.whyZh: 臨街入口在登船期間一度顯示錯誤，兩項條件都符合；出發前改正不會抹去那段錯誤，人數仍保留但運量分析須先擱置。

options.text: A wrong time appeared at the street entrance before boarding, but staff corrected it before anyone began to board.
options.zh: 登船前臨街入口顯示了錯誤時間，但工作人員在任何人開始登船之前已更正。
options.whyZh: 出錯的確在臨街入口，但已在登船開始前修正，並未發生於規則要看的時段。

options.text: A wrong time appeared on the boarding ramp during boarding while the street entrance continued to show the correct time.
options.zh: 登船期間斜坡通道上的看板顯示了錯誤時間，但臨街入口持續顯示正確時間。
options.whyZh: 錯誤發生在登船期間，但位置是斜坡通道而非規則要看的臨街入口。

options.text: A wrong time appeared at the street entrance only after boarding had ended and the ferry had left.
options.zh: 臨街入口只在登船結束、渡輪已開出後才顯示錯誤時間。
options.whyZh: 位置符合，但錯誤只出現在登船結束之後，不是登船期間。

explanationZh: 臨街入口在登船期間一度顯示錯誤，兩項條件都符合；出發前改正不會抹去那段錯誤，人數仍保留但運量分析須先擱置。

vocabulary.note: 不是從人數統計刪除，而是先不拿來估算加開班次。

evidence: whether the street entrance displayed the correct departure during boarding. / tag the run for separate analysis if that display was wrong at any point while passengers were boarding. / An error seen only at another location or outside that time does not need the tag. / A tagged run will not be used to estimate the effect of adding another ferry until the planner reviews the sign discrepancy.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: whether the street entrance displayed the correct departure during boarding.
tag the run for separate analysis if that display was wrong at any point while passengers were boarding.
An error seen only at another location or outside that time does not need the tag.
A tagged run will not be used to estimate the effect of adding another ferry until the planner reviews the sign discrepancy.
